name: Acid Stepper Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Basslines, leads, stabs and sequences for Acid Stepper across acid, techno, house, deep house, electro, trance, breakbeat, hip-hop, synthwave, dub, industrial and garage. Sequence tunes bring their own 16-step line; the others are played from a keyboard or an external sequencer.
